title: Chapter 483 The Last Cry Of The Emperor Ba
content:
Chapter 483 The Last Cry Of The Emperor Ba

"Bang."

After a loud noise, he vomited blood.

Gong Zheng used the move "Taishan Pressing Down the Top", and Wang Shuo added the move "Flying Dragon in the Sky".

Li Yijun also suffered in the northwest.

Under the joint siege of the crowd, the remaining assassins could only flee in embarrassment.

More than ten people escaped.

This sneak attack can be said to have lost both the wife and the soldiers of the Parthian Empire. Not only did it fail to kill the high-level officials of the Wana Empire, but it also suffered heavy losses.

The next morning, Wang Shuo, who was furious, immediately gave an order.

"Attack."

As the commander-in-chief of the military, Ayub was also a little angry in his heart, and he personally led the Golden Fire Cavalry to charge.

The battle started. Due to the number of the strongest kings on the opposite side, more than half of them were lost last night, and there was no resistance at all.

The defeat was like a mountain collapsing.

Ayub led the army and defeated the main force of the Parthian Empire in one go.

This battle not only occupied the Parthian Empire, but also weakened the strength of the Badandiya Empire.

It can be said to kill two birds with one stone.

The Badandian Empire went from strong to weak.

Just when Wang Shuo was about to attack the Badandian Empire in one go, the Mininia Empire in the west also felt that something was wrong.

Immediately attacked the border of the Vana Empire.

Wang Shuo received the news and sighed. Everyone was not stupid. Everyone understood the principle of lips and teeth being cold.

But the opportunity in front of him was rare, and Wang Shuo did not want to give up.

He immediately sent a message to the Maka Empire in the north, asking him to attack the Minimia Empire as soon as possible.

A war involving four first-level empires broke out at once.

Sure enough, the Mininia Empire only sent a small number of troops to invade the border of the Vana Empire, and all the main forces were transferred to the north.

Wang Shuo also seized the time and attacked the Badandian Empire with all his strength.

But it was obvious that this was not a simple battle.

It took almost half a year to contribute to the Parthian Empire alone.

It would take at least 1 year to reach the capital of the Badandian Empire.

Because his territory was too large.

It had to be pushed forward step by step.

The war went very smoothly. After all, there were 30 strongest kings in Wang Shuo's army.

All the cities along the way basically had no power to compete with them.

Most of them collapsed at the first touch, and only a few large cities had the power to resist and could hold on for a few days.

But it could only delay the pace of Wang Shuo's army.

Moreover, the captives along the way could replenish the troops.

The number of servants was almost exceeding the number of regular troops.

Many generals of the Badandiya Empire were still very aware of the current situation.

Knowing that the empire was powerless to turn the tide, they defected to the Vana Empire and fought even more bravely, striving to achieve good enough military exploits in the Vana Empire, and maybe they could be rewarded in the future.

A year later, the army of the Vana Empire finally arrived at the gates of the city.

This was a war with no retreat.

The Badandiya Empire could no longer lose.

"Wang Shuo, do you really want to kill them all?"

The Badandiya Emperor flew over the city and roared at Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo also rose into the air.

"Emperor Ba, you are no longer a child. Don't have unrealistic fantasies."

Wang Shuo was determined to win this battle.

Now Wang Shuo has an overall advantage. As long as he doesn't capsize, there is almost no suspense in this battle.

"Wang Shuo, I will never surrender. You will pay a huge price if you want to capture this city."

"When the time comes, when the three of you fight for hegemony, you will also be defeated."

Wang Shuo sneered: "Then don't bother Emperor Ba, don't worry, I will spare your life, and then I will show you how I defeated the other two empires."
